args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring (and FIN-212)
require banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This caused
tests/test_money.py::test_half_even to fail in the nightly build.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` — contradicting its own docstring.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching FIN-212 and the existing docstring. Example: `2.665` now rounds to `2.66` instead of `2.67`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed.
